1283-1308-1651-3129-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Primal Vigor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1308-1651-3129-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

5900-6823-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-6823-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

6529-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-4460-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4460-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Cyclops of Eternal Fury can be omitted.

573-1558-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1417-1580-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1874-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-7494-7650.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

950-1636-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
950-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

2034-3000-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3000-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1824-2530-2932-3168.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-2932-3168.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-3168.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5497-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

539-5412-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2073-2419-4241.description:
Activate Treasure Vault by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Treasure Vault to become a creature until end of turn.
Treasure Vault dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Treasure Vault from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1379-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.

2267-2946-4050.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2267-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4659-5003-6554-6602.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4659-5003-6554-6602.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

719-1399-1606-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
719-1399-1606-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1423-2541-5646.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1423-2541-5646.description:
Attempt to draw card, instead choosing to mill 6 cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand.
If you milled a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card and discard Golgari Grave-Troll.
Repeat.
1423-2541-5646.notes: The combo fails if you do not mill a nonland card.

974-2612-4231.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to kill a creature.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2612-4231.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kill the Smaug token, triggering its ability creating fourteen Treasure, fourteen Clue and fourteen Food tokens.
Mirkwood Bats triggers 42 times, causing each opponent to lose 42 life.
If desired, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding fourteen mana of any color(s).
If you sacrificed the Treasures, Mirkwood Bats triggers fourteen times, causing each opponent to lose 14 life.

1636-4170-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-4170-4871-5686.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4981.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4050-4981.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

777-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
777-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

719-5256-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-5256-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-5256-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Snail, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Snail's power.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2837-3259-3471.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Ellivere of the Wild Court does not have summoning sickness.
2837-3259-3471.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ellivere of the Wild Court as attackers.
Ellivere of the Wild Court's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Ellivere of the Wild Court's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Ellivere of the Wild Court trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each combat phase.

731-2390-3372.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
731-2390-3372.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Cast Corrupted Conscience by paying {3}{U}{U}, attaching it to All Will Be One.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.

1953-2743-4493.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional token.
1953-2743-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Biovisionary token.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

4013-4659-4745.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Falkenrath Celebrants.
Falkenrath Celebrants enters the battlefield, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the two Blood tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1021-2440-4050-5321.description:
Activate Squirrel Wrangler by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Drownyard Temple, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Both Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Squirrel on the battlefield.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Squirrel token, adding {G}.
Repeat.

332-618-908.description:
Cast Thoughtlace to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1049-1283-1308-2034.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax (if applicable)
1049-1283-1308-2034.description:
Cast Jirina Kudro by paying {4}, plus commander tax if necessary.
When Jirina Kudro enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens for each time you've cast a commander from the command zone this game.
Activate Ashnod's Altar multiple times by sacrificing Jirina Kudro and all of your Human Soldier tokens, adding {C}{C} each time.
Repeat.

1413-1636.notablePrerequisites: Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
1413-1636.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human token.
Human token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat
